english.title: Fail to surrender revoked / suspended / varied certificate / licence etc. to CAA
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the holder]_
(B)_[a person having the possession or custody of]_

(C)_[a certificate]_
(D)_[a licence]_
(E)_[an approval]_
(F)_[a permission]_
(G)_[an exemption]_
(H)_[a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..),]_

which had been revoked, suspended or varied under

(I)_[the Air Navigation Order 2016,]_
(J)_[a Safety Regulation, namely **(..SPECIFY SAFETY REGULATION..),]_

failed to surrender it to the CAA within a reasonable time of being required to do so by the CAA
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 253(3) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the holder or a person having the possession or custody of
a certificate, licence, approval, permission, exemption or document
which had been revoked, suspended or varied under the Air Navigation Order 2016 or a Safety Regulation
failed to surrender it to the CAA within a reasonable time of being required to do so by the CAA

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Article 253 was amended on Exit Day to include certificates / licences etc. that have been revoked, suspended or varied under a Safety Regulation - for offences prior to Exit Day, see offence document H12819.
